8493119.author: user_my9bnzm29bleio17
8493119.reason: Reports a working WoW:Forever beta workaround (Interface 16001, newer Ace3); an implied support wish, not a direct ask.
8493119.text: I got this working with the October patch of WoW:forever beta by changing the version in the .toc file (## Interface: 16001) and updated the Ace3 Libraries. If you are looking for something to simply give you party target frames, this is it!
